question: A 2-year-old girl is brought to clinic because she cannot yet walk independently and has no recognisable words. She was born at term with no perinatal complications. Her mother reports she also makes little eye contact and does not point to objects. Which statement BEST defines this child's condition?

answers.text: Language disorder — she meets criteria because expressive language delay is present

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. A single-domain deficit qualifies as a specific developmental delay, not global developmental delay. This child has deficits in at least two domains (gross motor and language), fulfilling the definition of global developmental delay.

answers.text: Global developmental delay — defined as significant delay in two or more developmental domains in a child under 5 years

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. Global developmental delay (GDD) is defined as delay in two or more developmental domains (motor, language, cognition, social-adaptive, or personal-social) in a child under 5 years of age. This child has both gross motor and language delays.

answers.text: Autism Spectrum Disorder — she has social communication deficits and absent language

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. While ASD is a possibility to investigate, a diagnosis cannot be made here based solely on the delay history — a full structured clinical evaluation is required. GDD is the correct syndromic label describing two-domain delay at this point in the assessment.

answers.text: Specific language impairment — motor delay at this age is within normal variation

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Independent walking is expected by 12–15 months; a 2-year-old who cannot yet walk independently has a significant gross motor delay beyond normal variation. Both motor and language domains are affected, pointing to global developmental delay.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the definition: global developmental delay requires delay in two or more developmental domains (motor, language, cognition, social-adaptive, personal-social) in children under 5 years. A single-domain deficit is a specific delay, not GDD.
Well done. Global developmental delay is the correct term when two or more domains are significantly behind for the child's chronological age in a child under 5 years.
